en.name: Mahmoud Fadl
en.intro: I turn your message into visual stories that make people stop, understand, and connect. Motion design, AI video, and thoughtful editing — from the first frame to the last.
en.selected: A few stories, brought to life.

services.title: Motion design
services.desc: Explain the complex. Give your brand a visual rhythm. Product explainers, 2D and character animation, brand motion, and kinetic typography.

services.title: AI video & storytelling
services.desc: Bring ambitious concepts into view. AI-assisted scenes, visual development, compositing, and motion graphics shaped into a connected narrative.

services.title: Editing & sound
services.desc: Find the pace, emotion, and clarity in your footage. Video editing, sound design, colour finishing, and versions for social and advertising.

en.aboutTitle: A creative partner. From idea to final frame.
en.about: I’m Mahmoud, an independent senior motion designer and visual storyteller. Since 2017, I’ve been translating complex messages into character-led films, animated explanations, and AI-assisted stories. I work remotely with tech and SaaS companies, agencies, and marketing teams who care about both the idea and the craft.
en.aboutSmall: Motion designer · Visual storyteller · AI video specialist
en.processTitle: Clear steps. Space for good ideas.

steps.title: Discover
steps.desc: Your audience, goal, materials, and the message that matters.

steps.title: Shape
steps.desc: Concept, storyboard, and a visual direction we agree on.

steps.title: Make
steps.desc: Animation, AI production, editing, and sound come together.

steps.title: Refine & deliver
steps.desc: Two revision rounds, final exports, and 7 days of technical support.

faqs.a: Simple editing projects start at $300–500 depending on scope. Motion design and AI video receive a custom quote based on length, complexity, and deliverables.

faqs.q: What is included in the quote?
faqs.a: Deliverables are agreed before production. Scriptwriting, voice-over, and licensed music are additional unless explicitly included in your proposal.
You’ll receive a timeline after the brief. Production starts once your materials are received and the visual direction is approved.

faqs.q: Can you work with our team?
faqs.a: Yes. I collaborate remotely with agencies, tech companies, and marketing teams worldwide, either on a complete film or a defined production role.
Two revision rounds are included, plus 7 days of technical support for export or final-file issues after delivery. New creative directions sit outside that support and are quoted separately.

steps.title: نراجع ونسلّم
steps.desc: جولتان من التعديلات، ملفات نهائية، و7 أيام دعم فني للتصدير.

faqs.a: المونتاج البسيط يبدأ من 300–500$ حسب النطاق. الموشن وفيديو AI لهما عرض سعر مخصص حسب المدة والتعقيد والمخرجات.
نتفق على المخرجات قبل الإنتاج. كتابة السكريبت والتعليق الصوتي والموسيقى المرخصة إضافات، إلا إذا ذُكرت ضمن العرض.
أحدد جدولًا زمنيًا بعد فهم المشروع. تبدأ المدة بعد استلام المواد واعتماد الاتجاه البصري.
نعم، أعمل عن بُعد مع الوكالات وشركات التقنية وفرق التسويق عالميًا، لتنفيذ فيلم متكامل أو دور إنتاج محدد.

faqs.q: كم جولة تعديل، وهل هناك دعم بعد التسليم؟
faqs.a: جولتان من التعديلات، و7 أيام من الدعم الفني البسيط لمشكلات الملف النهائي أو التصدير بعد التسليم. التغييرات الإبداعية الجديدة ليست ضمن الدعم وتُسعّر بشكل منفصل.

en.title: Bending the possibilities.
en.subtitle: Harald · Product explainer
en.role: Motion Designer, 2D & Character Animator, AI Video Artist, Video Editor & Sound Designer
en.story: A character-led explainer exploring the bendability of Knauf AQUAPANEL boards. Guided by Harald, the film connects a technical material property with architectural design possibilities through animated explanations and project imagery.

en.title: A journey. A connection.

en.role: Motion Designer & AI Video Artist; video editing
en.story: An AI-assisted visual story following Sarah’s digital journey with Knauf: discovering branded content, visiting the website, making an enquiry, and meeting the team. AI scenes, interface sequences, and motion graphics connect the stages of awareness, consideration, and purchase.

ar.title: رحلة عميل، وقصة تواصل.
ar.subtitle: سارة · رحلة العميل الرقمية
ar.role: موشن ديزاين وفيديو بالذكاء الاصطناعي ومونتاج

en.title: Making the message clear.
en.subtitle: Public health · Regional response
en.story: A motion-led public health film presenting substance-use challenges and regional response efforts in the Eastern Mediterranean. Animated data, maps, typography, and filmed material structure a complex message around the challenge, the response, and the call to action.

ar.title: رسالة معقدة، رؤية أوضح.
ar.subtitle: الصحة العامة · الاستجابة الإقليمية

en.title: Everyday life. Animated.
en.subtitle: Neighbourhood shop · Episode 02
en.story: A character-driven branded animation set in a neighbourhood shop. Sudanese dialogue and everyday humour weave Alzahabi products into a familiar exchange between a shopkeeper and a customer, in a visual world suited to an ongoing series.

ar.title: حكايات يومية، بروح متحركة.

en.title: Future forms, made visible.

en.story: A vertical architectural film that brings AQUAPANEL applications into futuristic built environments. Product imagery, spatial transitions and graphic information turn material specifications into a visual design journey.

en.title: Money moves. The story follows.
en.subtitle: Fawry · Banking explainer
en.story: A character-led animated explainer for Fawry money transfers. Friendly illustrated figures, a map and concise Arabic typography make the steps and reach of the service easy to follow.

ar.title: التحويل أسهل لما الحكاية تتحرك.
ar.subtitle: فوري · شرح خدمة التحويلات

en.title: A booking journey in motion.

en.story: A vertical walkthrough of the Bookify site, moving from the opening screen through search, guest details and payment. The edit focuses attention on the interface and the flow from discovery to reservation.

ar.title: رحلة حجز واضحة من أول نقرة.

en.title: A familiar moment, told warmly.
en.subtitle: Bushraa · Lifestyle film

ar.title: لحظة يومية، بقصة دافئة.
ar.subtitle: بشرى · فيلم حياتي
ar.story: فيلم حياتي دافئ تدور لقطاته حول البيت والطعام والتفاعل اليومي. التفاصيل القريبة واللحظات الإنسانية تمنح قصة العلامة إحساسًا مألوفًا وقريبًا.

en.title: The energy of an event, in one story.

en.title: A product world with a fresh pulse.

en.story: A short product-focused film using a dark stage, animated ingredients and lively colour. The composition builds from a single bottle into a fresh, sensory brand world.

en.title: Many stories. One creative pulse.
en.subtitle: Break Logic · Production showcase

ar.title: حكايات كثيرة بإيقاع إبداعي واحد.

en.title: A greeting shaped for Eid.
en.subtitle: Africa & Gulf Bank · Eid film

en.story: A compact Eid al-Adha brand film that brings a festive message to a clear closing identity. The square format is suited to social sharing and seasonal campaign placement.

ar.title: تهنئة عيد بهوية واضحة.

en.story: A vertical talking-head video that keeps the speaker at the centre while supporting key points with Arabic on-screen text. The pacing and framing suit direct viewing on mobile social platforms.

ar.title: رسالة شخصية في كادر واضح.
ar.subtitle: د. زينب · فيديو اجتماعي

en.title: One angle. More attitude.

ar.subtitle: مشهد سيارة · تجربة زاوية سفلية

en.title: A message carried by rhythm.

ar.title: رسالة تحملها الكلمات والإيقاع.

ar.story: فيديو عربي تقوده الكلمات، يبني رسالته بإيقاع نصي ولوحة خضراء هادئة ولمسات جرافيكية صغيرة. تظل القراءة في المركز بينما تدعم الحركة الفهم والتأكيد.
